name: application-vertical-step-tabs
title: Vertical Step Tabs
description: Left rail of numbered, freely-navigable tabs that swap the right-pane content — unlike a linear wizard, any step can be selected at any time.
useWhen: Building a settings or multi-section panel (Profile, Security, Notifications, Billing) where any section can be jumped to directly.
You want a numbered rail purely as a visual/organizational device, not to represent completion progress.
The content pane is wide enough to justify a persistent left rail rather than a horizontal tab strip.
avoidWhen: You're building a linear, sequential onboarding flow where earlier steps must be completed before later ones unlock — use `step-progress-sidebar` for that completion-tracking case instead.
There are more than 5-6 sections — a long vertical rail is harder to scan than a searchable settings list.
The panel is narrow (mobile) — collapse to a horizontal scroller or a select instead of a fixed-width rail.
responsiveBehavior: Rail width is fixed; on narrow viewports the two-pane layout should be swapped for a stacked or single-pane-at-a-time pattern rather than compressing the rail.
accessibility: The rail uses role=tablist/role=tab with aria-orientation=vertical and aria-selected reflecting the active section.
The active tab is distinguished by a filled number badge, background, and ring — not the number color alone — so it reads correctly without color vision.
The content pane is a single role=tabpanel that swaps content on selection, keeping one landmark rather than mounting/unmounting multiple panels.

variants.title: Vertical Step Tabs
variants.description: Four numbered sections (Profile, Security, Notifications, Billing) with Profile active, showing a profile-edit panel.
accessibility: Numbers are sequential labels for orientation, not step-completion indicators, so no checkmark/complete semantics are implied for earlier tabs.

variants.title: Vertical Step Tabs (Dark)
variants.description: Vertical step tabs adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: The active tab's ring and background are tuned to remain distinguishable from inactive tabs against the dark rail surface.
